segments.name: Online Education
segments.evidence: We provide comprehensive online interactive live courses for K-12 students in the United States and around the globe.

revenueModel.text: Students and their families pay the company for time-based and credit-based subscriptions to its online live courses.
revenueModel.evidence: Disaggregated information of revenues by stream are as follows: Year Ended December 31, 2025 2024 Revenues: Time-based subscriptions $ 854,851 $ 1,161,383 Credit-based subscriptions 2,511,570 2,214,221 Marketing revenues (related party) — 300,000

changes.text: In 2025, the company consummated a business combination with BFAC, a SPAC, through which Class Over became its wholly-owned subsidiary.
changes.evidence: On April 4, 2025, The Company consummated a business combination with Classover DE and BFAC (the SPAC), resulting in a reverse recapitalization.
